steps.note: The milk is brought to the temperature at which rennet works.
The milk is soured by the starter before the rennet goes in.
The curd is cut when it splits cleanly, like glass.
The batch is drained as whey, about 30–50 % of its volume early on, and the rest shortly before the vat is emptied.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Cheese

sources.text: The renneting temperature, starter, rennet dose, coagulation time, cutting and whey draining are from this chapter, which pasteurises the cheese milk (72-73 °C) before these steps.
